newsitem.title: USA: CNS sees ad campaign boosting Q4 sales.
newsitem.headline: CNS sees ad campaign boosting Q4 sales.

text.p: CNS Inc, which earlier reported higher third-quarter earnings, said it expected fourth-quarter sales to benefit from an advertising campaign for Breathe Right.

"This is the first time we have aggressively marketed the product for nasal congestion, and the network TV component of the program will take us to a broader audience," said Daniel Cohen, chairman and chief executive. "We expect this exposure to give a strong push to sales in the fourth quarter."
Earlier, CNS said it earned $3.9 million, or $0.19 a share, in the third quarter versus $1.4 million, or $0.07 a share, in the same period last year.
"We are pleased that domestic sales of the Breathe Right product at retail continue at approximately twice the year-earlier level, based on the most recent data available," he said.
CNS has launched a national roll-out of Thera-Patch, a topical analgesic, but does not expect this product to produce significant revenue until advertising is launched in mid-1997.
